sloka: शोकेन महता ग्रस्ता मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।न शर्म लभते भीरुः पाश बद्धा मृगी यथा ॥३-५६-३५॥
transliteration: śokena mahatā grastā maithilī janakātmajā ।na śarma labhate bhīruḥ pāśa baddhā mṛgī yathā ॥3-56-35॥

translations.english: Sita, daughter of Janaka, immersed in deep grief knew no peace just like a doe caught in a snare.
